name: Strategic Change and Flexibility
description:
This course contains the following topics:
Patterns of change, modelling strategic change
Need for strategic flexibility at the enterprise level: Openness, adaptiveness, change and resilience, managing chaos strategically
Core competence and flexibility in strategy
Flowing stream strategy – A conceptual framework (Valuation of Flexibility)
Managing continuity and change: Making connections, Team building, Strategic alliances
The dynamic, flexible and responsive organization, organizational revitalization, inspiring leaders, improving governance
